preprocessing: "\n\n".join(test["text"]); one tokenizer call on the whole text; no special tokens are added
packing: non-overlapping 512-token windows i*512..(i+1)*512; 584 complete windows; 128 sampled by random.Random(20261108).sample, sorted; tail discarded
scoring: logits[:, :-1] vs input_ids[:, 1:]; the first token of each window is context only; FP32 cross entropy, FP64 accumulation; PPL = exp(total NLL / total targets); no attention mask (complete windows, no padding); positions restart at 0 in every window

decision_rule.tau: 3 x max(|BF16 run1 - run2|, |BF16 across processes|, |FR s0 - FR s0 repeat|) in PPL units, floored at 1e-4 x PPL_BF16
decision_rule.PPL-RECON-ALIGNED: PPL(FC) - PPL(FR) > tau on 3/3 seeds AND FC has the highest mean PPL of the four AND Spearman(recon, PPL) over the 12 configs >= 0.5
decision_rule.PPL-RECON-DISAGREE: PPL(FC) - PPL(FR) < -tau on 3/3 seeds OR Spearman(recon, PPL) <= -0.5
decision_rule.PPL-RECON-WEAKLY-RELATED: otherwise (differences within tau, inconsistent across seeds, or ranking not reproduced)
decision_rule.PPL-RUN-BLOCKED: BF16 baseline or any of the 12 configurations missing or failing a correctness check
decision_rule.recon_reference: matched-warm-start old-test-split reconstruction (runs_typicality_matched); the locked confirmation reconstruction is reported alongside

model_scope: PARTIAL: GPTQ fake-quantized routed experts (gate/up/down) of layers 1/8/16/23 only; everything else BF16
